description: Label and group Python ecosystem updates, keeping majors in their own PR and the interpreter selector out of the package group

packageRules.description: Group non-major Python updates into a single PR
Label all Copier template updates. copier is already matched by the python category rules above, so this adds the copier label on top rather than replacing them
Group non-major Copier template updates into a single PR. copier is itself in the python category, so this rule must stay after the category rules above in order to override their group name

A .python-version or .tool-versions file selects the interpreter this repo builds with, so it leaves the package group and moves on its own. Point mise at it with idiomatic_version_file_enable_tools rather than repeating the version as a mise python entry. The requires-python floor in pyproject.toml is not extracted by any manager, so it stays a review convention. Keep this rule after the package and Copier groups so the selector leaves them
